## REQ-R-01: Reference corpus expansion

## REQ-R-02: Translation layer

- [ ] Title "STATEMENT OF WORK #001" renders centered, bold, 16pt
- [ ] Italic subtitle "Pursuant to Master Services Agreement..." renders centered + italic
- [ ] Headings "1. Engagement Summary" / "2. Deliverables and Payment Schedule" / "3. Acceptance Criteria" render as h1 (largest)
- [ ] Subheadings "1.1 Scope of Work" / "3.1 Defect Severity" render as h2 (smaller than h1, larger than body)
- [ ] Source-doc page break between §2 table content and §3 Acceptance Criteria results in §3 starting on new page

## REQ-R-02 — Table-specific:

- [ ] Table renders with 4 columns (Item #, Deliverable, Due Date, Payment) and 7 rows (1 header + 6 data)
- [ ] Header row visually distinct (bold + grey shading `#f3f4f6`)
- [ ] Column widths roughly proportional: ~15% / ~40% / ~20% / ~25%
- [ ] "Item #" column cells center-aligned
- [ ] "Deliverable" column cells left-aligned, multi-line content wraps within cell
- [ ] "Due Date" column cells center-aligned
- [ ] "Payment (CAD)" column cells right-aligned
- [ ] Cell borders visible (1px solid black or equivalent)

## REQ-R-03: TextStyle / font preservation

- [ ] Title at 16pt
- [ ] Subtitle italic at 11pt
- [ ] Inline bold "Total contract value:" and severity-level labels ("Critical:", "High:", etc.) preserved

## REQ-R-04: Headers / footers

- [ ] No source-doc header/footer → empty top/bottom margins
- [ ] No auto "Page N of M" rendered

## REQ-R-05: Word-style theming

- [ ] Headings carry `data-docx-style="Heading 1"` / `"Heading 2"`
- [ ] Body paragraphs carry `data-docx-style="Normal"` (or equivalent)

## REQ-R-06: Phase 01 collab preserved

- [ ] CommentMark on table cell content persists
- [ ] InsertionMark / DeletionMark on a deliverable description renders correctly
- [ ] Two-window concurrent edit converges

## REQ-R-07: Performance

- [ ] Loads end-to-end in < 5 seconds
- [ ] Typing in mid-document maintains <16ms per keystroke
